passage.text: Day 1: Today I started a new challenge: thirty days without sugar!
passage.reading: ˈdeɪ ˈwʌn: təˈdeɪ aɪ ˈstɑːrtɪd ə ˈnuː ˈtʃæləndʒ: ˈθɜːrti ˈdeɪz wɪˈðaʊt ˈʃʊɡər!

passage.text: I gave up soft drinks, candy and cookies.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈɡeɪv ˈʌp ˈsɔːft ˈdrɪŋks, ˈkændi ənd ˈkʊkiz.

passage.text: It's going to be hard because I love sweet things.
passage.reading: ɪts ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə bi ˈhɑːrd bɪˈkɔːz aɪ ˈlʌv ˈswiːt ˈθɪŋz.

passage.text: Day 10: This week was very difficult.
passage.reading: ˈdeɪ ˈtɛn: ðɪs ˈwiːk wʌz ˈvɛri ˈdɪfɪkəlt.

passage.text: At my cousin's birthday party, everyone ate cake, but I only drank water.
passage.reading: ət maɪ ˈkʌzənz ˈbɜːrθdeɪ ˈpɑːrti, ˈɛvriwʌn ˈeɪt ˈkeɪk, bʌt aɪ ˈoʊnli ˈdræŋk ˈwɔːtər.

passage.text: But I have more energy now, and I don't feel sleepy after lunch.
passage.reading: bʌt aɪ ˈhæv ˈmɔːr ˈɛnərdʒi ˈnaʊ, ənd aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈfiːl ˈsliːpi ˈæftər ˈlʌntʃ.

passage.text: I didn't eat any sugar for thirty days.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈiːt ˈɛni ˈʃʊɡər fər ˈθɜːrti ˈdeɪz.

passage.text: I've lost two kilos, and I sleep much better.
passage.reading: aɪv ˈlɔːst ˈtuː ˈkiːloʊz, ənd aɪ ˈsliːp ˈmʌtʃ ˈbɛtər.

passage.text: Tomorrow I'm going to have a small piece of chocolate cake.
passage.reading: təˈmɑːroʊ aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈhæv ə ˈsmɔːl ˈpiːs əv ˈtʃɔːklət ˈkeɪk.
